title: Deduplicate numbers in order of first appearance
goal: Use Set to retain unique values ​​and convert back to an array.
summary: Duplicate numbers will be added after merging multiple scans. The first occurrence of each number is preserved when importing.
tasks: completes uniqueCodes(codes) and returns an array containing only unique codes, in order of first occurrence.
retains the string and the number itself, "4" and 4 are regarded as different encodings.

example.note: Set is insertion order, and the array can be obtained using expansion syntax.

hint: directly constructs a new Set(codes) based on the input, and then expands it into [].
